title: The Badge in the Ditch
lines: Ben lost his little badge in a ditch.
It fell off his black vest.
Ben and Meg dig in the wet mud.
Meg finds a stick and a big rock.
Then Ben spots it by the ditch edge.
The badge is stuck in thick mud.
He tugs it up and rubs the mud off.
Meg pins the badge back on his vest.

questions.ask: Where did Ben lose his badge?
questions.listenFor: In a ditch. It fell off his black vest.

questions.ask: Who spotted the badge, Ben or Meg?
questions.listenFor: Ben spotted it by the ditch edge. Meg found a stick and a rock first - a nice trap for a fast guesser.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg was a good friend? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for a reason, like she helped him dig.
